emails_due_today.body:
Hi Priya,

Thank you for your time yesterday. You told me "Our front desk spends the whole morning on reminder calls" and "Monday no-shows are killing us", so here is what I heard and what we agreed.

What I heard
- About 30 no-shows a week across your 6 clinics, mostly on Monday mornings.
- Two clinics book on a paper diary; the other four share a Google Calendar.
- The parts you need: reminders, deposits for first visits and one booking page per clinic.

What we agreed
- Me: pricing for all 6 clinics by Thursday, October 29.
- You: share it with Dana Whitfield, who signs anything over $5,000 a year.
- Both: a call with you and Dana on Wednesday, November 4 at 10:00 am.

Still open
- Ken Alvarez will want to see how calendar sync works with Google Calendar. I'll include the calendar sync page with the pricing.
- [confirm: whether you start with two clinics or all six]. We can settle that on the call with Dana.

Could you confirm that November 4 at 10:00 am works for Dana, so I can send the invite?

Taylor
